intro.text: The Southern Sea. In Classical times, the Bennet people who lived on the Southern Islands were known as fine sailors.
A sea of Scadrial, known as the Southern Sea before the Catacendre. Elendel and Bilming, two of the world's most important ports, lie on it, and the Irongate River reaches it by way of Hammondar Bay.

description.text: It covers most of the water between the old Southern Dominance and the Southern Islands, and connects to the Sea of Lennes.
In the Final Empire's day, a few settlements stood on its northeastern shores, near the mouth of the River Channerel and Ashmount Doriel.
